title: Actor
description: TOGAF-sourced structural archetype — person, organization, or system that performs actions within the architecture. An active system with Mechanisms (functions it performs), Effectors (outputs it produces), and Receptors (inputs it receives). Actors PLAY Roles (see Role archetype) — the Actor is who; the Role is the responsibility. Extends Structure with TOGAF Business Architecture vocabulary. TOGAF mapping: Actor (Content Metamodel, Business Architecture domain). Source framework: TOGAF (Business Architecture, Content Framework).

actorType.description: Actor classification. PERSON = individual human actor. ORGANIZATION = external organizational entity. SYSTEM = automated actor. TOGAF mapping: Actor type (Content Metamodel).

scope.description: Actor scope relative to the enterprise boundary. TOGAF mapping: Actor boundary classification.
